title: Woman’s unclean loins
html_source: The Old Testament descrbes women as being: “unclean for seven days” after childbirth. (Lev. 12:2)

anchor.prefix: her old head to a voice that speaks to her loudly, her bonesetter, her medicineman: me she slights. To the voice that will shrive and oil for the grave all there is of her but her

, of man's flesh made not in God's likeness, the serpent's prey. And to the loud voice that now bids her be silent with wondering unsteady eyes.
